summary: fix(content-server): serve the pair connect_hint route on reload
description:
Because:

* Reloading /pair/supplicant/connect_hint returned the content-server 404
  because only the settings router knew about the path.

This commit:

* Adds pair/supplicant/connect_hint to the content-server frontend route
  list and to the pair2 React route group.

Closes #FXA-14603
